review.en: Ryuichi Sakamoto's first solo album in eight years, made after treatment for throat cancer, imagined as the soundtrack to a film by Andrei Tarkovsky that does not exist. Piano and organ sit beside field recordings, prepared sounds and voices reading poetry, often out of step on purpose, as the title says. It is a late work about time, decay and attention, made by a composer listening very closely.
review.zh: 坂本龙一治疗喉癌之后的作品，也是他八年来第一张个人专辑，被设想为一部并不存在的塔可夫斯基电影的配乐。钢琴和管风琴旁边是野外录音、加工过的声响和朗读诗句的人声，正如标题所说，常常故意不同步。这是一部关于时间、衰败与专注的晚期作品，出自一位听得极细的作曲家。
